DMK Leaders Booked Over Alleged Remarks Against CT Nirmal Kumar

DMK leaders A. Raja and Sekar Babu have been booked by police following alleged derogatory remarks made against CT Nirmal Kumar. The specific nature of the remarks and the exact date they were made are not detailed in the coverage. The booking of the leaders is based on complaints filed against them.
